title: Passive Fire Protection Applicator/Inspector
description:
Location: Offshore Guayana (Rotational Basis)
Industry: Oil & Gas
Department: Coatings & Fire Protection

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Passive Fire Protection (PFP) Applicator/Inspectors to join our team supporting FPSO Uaru that is scheduled to arrive in Guayana in the second half of 2026 . The ideal candidate has hands-on experience applying and inspecting certified PFP coating systems — including epoxy intumescent products such as International Paint's Chartek series — and is familiar with applicable fire resistance standards and project documentation requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Apply passive fire protection coatings (epoxy intumescent, cementitious) to structural steel, vessels, and piping in accordance with manufacturer specifications and project requirements.
  • Inspect PFP installations for correct DFT (dry film thickness), surface preparation, and coverage using calibrated instruments.
  • Review and interpret PFP product certificates, system design drawings, and application guides.
  • Ensure all work complies with relevant standards (UL 1709, BS 476, EN13381, NFPA).
  • Maintain and complete inspection records, quality control documentation, and material traceability logs.
  • Coordinate with QA/QC teams, project engineers, and third-party inspectors.
  • Identify and report non-conformances and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
  • Ensure safe handling and storage of PFP materials on site.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on PFP application or inspection experience in oil & gas, petrochemical, or heavy industrial construction.
  • Familiarity with epoxy intumescent coating systems (e.g., International Paint Chartek, Interchar).
  • AMPP (NACE/SSPC) Coating Inspector certification (CIP Level 1 or 2) or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of surface preparation standards (SSPC/NACE/ISO 8501).
  • Ability to read and interpret technical data sheets, PFP certificates, and engineering drawings.
  • OSHA 10 or OSHA 30 certification.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ICorr PFP Coating Inspector (Epoxy) Level 2 certification.
  • FIRAS or equivalent third-party PFP installer certification.
  • Experience with International Paint (AkzoNobel) Chartek or Interchar product systems.
  • Familiarity with UL 1709 (hydrocarbon fire) and jet fire testing standards.
  • Experience on offshore or onshore oil & gas facilities.

Work Environment

This position involves work on a FSPO with confined spaces, elevated structures, and areas requiring full PPE. Work will be offshore and be on a rotational basis.

Key Certifications Referenced

AMPP CIP Level 1/2 — Coating inspection certification (formerly NACE/SSPC)
ICorr PFP Inspector (Epoxy) Level 2 — Specialist epoxy intumescent inspection certification
FIRAS — Third-party PFP installer certification (Warringtonfire/UKAS accredited)
UL 1709 — Standard for rapid rise fire testing of protection materials for structural steel

Pay will be in accordance with current industry standards and experience. Candidates for these positions should submit Resume/CV to: jobs@aimws.com
